description: This file contains utility functions for estimating character counts in agent messages, including handling different message roles, content types, and caching mechanisms. It is specific to the 'pi-embedded-runner' agent in the project.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message is a tool result message based on role or type.

methods.name: getToolResultText
methods.description: Extracts and joins text content from a tool result message.

methods.name: createMessageCharEstimateCache
methods.description: Creates a new cache for message character estimates.

methods.name: estimateMessageCharsCached
methods.description: Estimates message character count with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: estimateContextChars
methods.description: Calculates total character count for a list of messages using cache.

methods.name: invalidateMessageCharsCacheEntry
methods.description: Removes a message's cache entry to force re-estimation.
